gap_criteria.closure_criteria: Implement the actual ordered caller in Rust: FFA, original hopper options, count feasibility and allowed imbalance, weighted optimized assignment, and type-3-only individual retry. Preserve raw weights, grouping/traversal order, failure transitions and clan admission. Replay complete callers and real dispatch, not just a `>2` branch edit.

Give Rust distinct raw, effective, previous and public-rank types/fields. Trace and replay original producers/consumers for remote parties, independently signed local accounts, guests and clans. Distinguish `F(H)` from the decompiled double-inverse error. Do not guess a universal adjustment.

Verify genuine admission, exact variant, ordinary actions and natural endings through results, public/hidden/clan progression, PCR, party return and requeue for every applicable profile/variant. Include local/remote ownership, ties, departures and migration. Keep shortened/component tests labeled.

Preserve and parse legitimate original/default and downloaded inputs separately. Recover complete dated hopper/network data, weights and variant buffers, including the historical inventory and Team Carnage/HBO checkpoint. Record provenance and unresolved cells/fields. Never synthesize historical values.

Move the replacement policy into an explicitly named Rust provider boundary. Preserve ordered banks into the client decision core. Seek distinguishing original request/response evidence or procedure definitions; keep original-service parity open until recovered.

Implement Rust validation/finalization and an explicit authority/dispute/quarantine policy. Test absent, late, duplicate, conflicting and disconnected reports plus couch ownership and restart/retry. Preserve security; label modern arbitration until original title-specific evidence exists.

Put matchmaking host/session decisions in Rust. Trace original eligibility, generations, clocks, QoS units and caller state. Prove actual existing-world continuity under graceful/abrupt host loss and ordinary departures for all families, including meaningful objective/role/fuse state. Keep route-measurement differences explicit.

Implement original ordered LCG draw and full-row selection in Rust, with explicit RNG ownership/call order, duplicate rows, map predicates, clamps, output/failure behavior and complete 304-byte settings. Replay signed-short boundary behavior before extending the demonstrated safe domain. Do not use a random distribution approximation.

Build repeatable original/Rust comparisons with binary, runner, fixture, config, compiler and instruction identities. Use existing genuine inputs. Regenerate missing fixtures from originals rather than the implementation under test. Preserve rejected/failing cases and declare synthetic inputs.

Bind Rust source/build/library, actual selected client, server, catalog, profile and feature identities to acceptance receipts. Verify production-equivalent flow, config changes during an outstanding match, restart, rollback and installed delivery. A matching local binary digest alone does not close this row.

Introduce an immutable Rust admission/result envelope binding complete settings, executable/profile/catalog/map/rank identities, roster and authority generations, expiry and replay identity. Verify every upstream/downstream consumer and transactional player/clan namespace. Reject unfamiliar objective variants with missing authenticated settings rather than treating them as Slayer.

Update operational docs from actual selected routes and fresh receipts. Keep historical notes identified, distinguish source/component/live/deployed evidence, and maintain the intentional-deviation ledger. Do not replace accurate seven-family implementation with old Slayer-only claims.
